content.json:
# User Journey
What signed-in users viewed and did, from CoreDesign.UserJourney telemetry. Pick an app and a user to see their timeline. Anonymous traffic is not tracked per user; use an aggregate analytics tool for that.

parameters.name: App
parameters.label: App
parameters.query:
requests
| where isnotempty(cloud_RoleName)
| distinct cloud_RoleName
| project value = cloud_RoleName, label = cloud_RoleName
| union (datatable(value:string, label:string)["All", "All"])
| order by value asc

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.label: User
parameters.query:
union
(requests | where isnotempty(user_AuthenticatedId) | extend uid = user_AuthenticatedId),
(dependencies | extend uid = coalesce(user_AuthenticatedId, tostring(customDimensions["enduser.id"])) | where isnotempty(uid))
| where '{App}' == "All" or cloud_RoleName == '{App}'
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, displayName = tostring(customDimensions["user.name"])) by uid
| order by timestamp desc
| project value = uid, label = iff(isempty(displayName), uid, displayName)

content.query:
let uid = '{UserId}';
let userRequests = requests
| where user_AuthenticatedId == uid
| where '{App}' == "All" or cloud_RoleName == '{App}';
let userEvents = dependencies
| where type == "InProc"
| where user_AuthenticatedId == uid or tostring(customDimensions["enduser.id"]) == uid
| where '{App}' == "All" or cloud_RoleName == '{App}';
let ops = union (userRequests | project operation_Id), (userEvents | project operation_Id) | distinct operation_Id;
let viewed = union requests, dependencies
| where operation_Id in (ops) and isnotempty(customDimensions["view.item"])
| summarize itemType = take_any(tostring(customDimensions["view.type"])), item = take_any(tostring(customDimensions["view.item"])) by operation_Id;
let pages = userRequests
| where name startswith "GET /"
| extend path = tostring(parse_url(url).Path)
| where not(path matches regex @"\.[A-Za-z0-9]{2,5}$") and path !startswith "/_" 
| project timestamp, operation_Id, Step = "Viewed page", What = path, Result = resultCode;
let browserPages = userEvents
| where tostring(customDimensions["user_journey.event"]) == "page"
| project timestamp, operation_Id, Step = "Viewed page", What = tostring(customDimensions["user_journey.path"]), Result = "";
let blazorClicks = userEvents
| where name startswith "Event "
| extend eventName = tostring(split(name, " ")[1]), functionName = tostring(customDimensions["code.function.name"]), page = tostring(split(tostring(customDimensions["aspnetcore.components.type"]), ".")[-1])
| project timestamp, operation_Id, Step = "Interacted", What = strcat(iff(isempty(functionName) or functionName startswith "<", eventName, functionName), iff(isempty(page), "", strcat(" on ", page))), Result = "";
let browserClicks = userEvents
| where tostring(customDimensions["user_journey.event"]) == "click"
| project timestamp, operation_Id, Step = "Interacted", What = strcat(tostring(customDimensions["user_journey.target"]), " on ", tostring(customDimensions["user_journey.path"])), Result = "";
let writeRequests = requests
| where operation_Id in (ops) or user_AuthenticatedId == uid
| where name matches regex @"^(POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE) " and name !has "/user-journey/events"
| where '{App}' == "All" or cloud_RoleName == '{App}'
| project timestamp, operation_Id, name, Result = resultCode;
let writeCalls = dependencies
| where type == "HTTP" and operation_Id in (ops)
| where name matches regex @"^(POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE) " and name !has "/user-journey/events"
| join kind=leftanti (writeRequests | project operation_Id) on operation_Id
| project timestamp, operation_Id, name, Result = resultCode;
let changes = union writeRequests, writeCalls
| extend verb = tostring(split(name, " ")[0]), resource = extract(@"^\w+ /?([^/ ]+)", 1, name)
| project timestamp, operation_Id, Step = "Changed data", What = strcat(case(verb == "POST", "Created ", verb == "DELETE", "Deleted ", "Updated "), resource), Result;
union pages, browserPages, blazorClicks, browserClicks, changes
| join kind=leftouter viewed on operation_Id
| extend What = iff(isempty(item) or Step != "Viewed page", What, strcat(What, " (", iff(isempty(itemType), "", strcat(itemType, ": ")), item, ")"))
| order by timestamp asc
| project Time = timestamp, Step, What, Result
content.title: Timeline for the selected user
content.noDataMessage: No activity for this user in the selected time range.

content.query:
union
(requests | extend uid = user_AuthenticatedId),
(dependencies | extend uid = coalesce(user_AuthenticatedId, tostring(customDimensions["enduser.id"])))
| where isnotempty(uid)
| where '{App}' == "All" or cloud_RoleName == '{App}'
| summarize Users = dcount(uid) by bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Signed-in users per day

content.query:
union
(requests
 | where isnotempty(user_AuthenticatedId) and name startswith "GET /"
 | extend path = tostring(parse_url(url).Path), uid = user_AuthenticatedId
 | where not(path matches regex @"\.[A-Za-z0-9]{2,5}$") and path !startswith "/_" ),
(dependencies
 | where tostring(customDimensions["user_journey.event"]) == "page"
 | extend path = tostring(customDimensions["user_journey.path"]), uid = coalesce(user_AuthenticatedId, tostring(customDimensions["enduser.id"])))
| where '{App}' == "All" or cloud_RoleName == '{App}'
| summarize Views = count(), Users = dcount(uid) by Page = path
| order by Views desc
| take 25
content.title: Most viewed pages, signed-in users

content.query:
union requests, dependencies
| where isnotempty(customDimensions["view.item"])
| where '{App}' == "All" or cloud_RoleName == '{App}'
| extend uid = coalesce(user_AuthenticatedId, tostring(customDimensions["enduser.id"]))
| where isnotempty(uid)
| summarize Views = count(), Users = dcount(uid), LastViewed = max(timestamp)
    by Type = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["view.type"]), "Item"), Item = tostring(customDimensions["view.item"])
| order by Views desc
| take 50
content.title: Items viewed (Journey.Viewed and JourneyView)
content.noDataMessage: No items recorded. Call Journey.Viewed or add a JourneyView component to record them.

content.query:
let writeRequests = requests
| where isnotempty(user_AuthenticatedId)
| where name matches regex @"^(POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE) " and name !has "/user-journey/events"
| where '{App}' == "All" or cloud_RoleName == '{App}'
| project operation_Id, name;
let userOps = union
(requests | where isnotempty(user_AuthenticatedId) | project operation_Id),
(dependencies | where type == "InProc" and (isnotempty(user_AuthenticatedId) or isnotempty(customDimensions["enduser.id"])) | project operation_Id)
| distinct operation_Id;
let writeCalls = dependencies
| where type == "HTTP" and operation_Id in (userOps)
| where name matches regex @"^(POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE) " and name !has "/user-journey/events"
| where '{App}' == "All" or cloud_RoleName == '{App}'
| join kind=leftanti (writeRequests | project operation_Id) on operation_Id
| project operation_Id, name;
union writeRequests, writeCalls
| extend verb = tostring(split(name, " ")[0]), resource = extract(@"^\w+ /?([^/ ]+)", 1, name)
| summarize Count = count() by Action = strcat(case(verb == "POST", "Created ", verb == "DELETE", "Deleted ", "Updated "), resource)
| order by Count desc
content.title: Most common data changes, signed-in users
